data.name: Christopher
data.gender_notes: Christopher is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek christos, 'Christ', + pherein, 'to bear' — 'bearer of Christ'. Its root is Greek christos + pherein. Saint Christopher, the patron of travellers. Christopher is a Greek name meaning “Bearer of Christ”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Christopher expresses “Bearer of Christ”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek christos, 'Christ', + pherein, 'to bear' — 'bearer of Christ'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Christopher total 67, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
